show.description:
A luxury bus journey spirals into a deadly power game when a simple misunderstanding ignites greed, ego, and brutal ambition.
Inside a secluded resort, truth is buried, identities are twisted, and a woman is branded a gold digger in a ruthless battle for wealth and control. But when secrets explode and loyalties are tested, the ultimate showdown proves that blood is thicker than power. Rich? Still Not Interested
